name: Maxan Anvol
summary: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Maxan Anvol trains dwarven priests in the Holy Light. He tests young acolytes before they earn the Church’s vestments.

sections.title: A Priest in the Pub
sections.body: Maxan Anvol tends to the hamlet’s spiritual welfare from the Thunderbrew Distillery, where travelers, mountaineers, and acolytes gather. Kharanos lies between Coldridge Valley and Ironforge, and its inn draws those who pass through. Maxan offers prayers and counsel to anyone who enters, with pints of stout close at hand.

sections.title: Testing the Faithful
sections.body: Maxan Anvol tests novice priests before they venture into the wider world. He has initiates use basic healing prayers on Dun Morogh’s wounded defenders. Those who show devotion and skill receive their first priestly vestments, marking their recognized place in the Church of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can I find Maxan Anvol?
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol can be found inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, the town’s inn and gathering place in Dun Morogh.
Maxan Anvol teaches novice and journeyman priests spells of holy healing, shadow control, and divine protection. He also teaches dwarven priests prayers such as Desperate Prayer.

faq.q: Why is a holy priest hanging out in a distillery?
faq.answer: Dwarven life and celebration gather around brewing and taverns. The Thunderbrew Distillery is Kharanos’s public gathering place and a rest for travelers, so Maxan can offer spiritual comfort to townsfolk, guards, and passersby.

faq.q: Does Maxan Anvol offer any special tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Maxan Anvol tests aspiring priests with trials such as 'In Favor of the Light' and 'Garments of the Light.' He sends them to heal injured mountaineers in the snow, and those who succeed earn their acolyte robes.

faq.q: What does he say to non-priests?
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol warns adventurers never to turn their backs on the Holy Light. Divine grace may be what saves their lives in battle.

faq.q: Can gnomes learn from Maxan Anvol?
faq.answer: Yes. Gnomes can train as priests, and Maxan welcomes any member of the Alliance who has pledged to the Light.

angles.text: As a priest, Maxan Anvol guides you early in Dun Morogh and opens the way to foundational holy discipline. He teaches racial prayers such as Desperate Prayer and awards your first church robes.
As a dwarf, you see Ironforge’s practical faith where people gather, beside the ale kegs of Kharanos.
As an Alliance member, you find Maxan tending to the physical and spiritual readiness of mountaineers and scouts who guard Dun Morogh from troggs, frost trolls, and wilderness beasts.
